solver_sql: SELECT step1.winner_id, step1.avg_loser_age, step1.avg_rank_ratio, step1.avg_loser_age - step2.overall_avg FROM (SELECT winner_id, AVG(loser_age) as avg_loser_age, AVG(CASE WHEN winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points != 0 THEN loser_rank_points / winner_rank_points END) as avg_rank_ratio FROM matches WHERE winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id) step1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_loser_age) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT winner_id, AVG(loser_age) as avg_loser_age FROM matches WHERE winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id)) step2 ORDER BY step1.avg_loser_age - step2.overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rank_points, AVG(m.loser_ht - m.winner_ht) as avg_height_diff FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_loser_rank_points) as avg_avg_loser_rank_points FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT p.hand, step1.avg_loser_rank_points, step1.avg_height_diff, step1.avg_loser_rank_points - step2.avg_avg_loser_rank_points as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_loser_rank_points > step2.avg_avg_loser_rank_points), step4 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_loser_rank_points) as avg_avg_loser_rank_points, AVG(avg_height_diff) as avg_avg_height_diff, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step3 GROUP BY hand) SELECT * FROM step4

SELECT AVG(avg_pts) as avg_avg_pts, SUM(cnt) as sum_count, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts, COUNT(*) as cnt, AVG(ranking_points) - (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) FROM rankings) as diff FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id HAVING AVG(ranking_points) > (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) FROM rankings))

SELECT p.hand, AVG(m.draw_size) as avg_draw, AVG(m.loser_rank_points - m.winner_rank_points) as avg_rank_diff, AVG(m.draw_size) - (SELECT AVG(m2.draw_size) FROM matches m2 JOIN players p2 ON m2.loser_id = p2.player_id) as diff FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.loser_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.hand

SELECT m.loser_id, AVG(m.draw_size) as avg_draw, AVG(m.draw_size) - (SELECT AVG(avg_draw) FROM (SELECT loser_id, AVG(draw_size) as avg_draw FROM matches GROUP BY loser_id)) as diff FROM matches m GROUP BY m.loser_id HAVING AVG(m.draw_size) > (SELECT AVG(avg_draw) FROM (SELECT loser_id, AVG(draw_size) as avg_draw FROM matches GROUP BY loser_id)) AND AVG(m.draw_size) > (SELECT AVG(avg_draw) FROM (SELECT loser_id, AVG(draw_size) as avg_draw FROM matches GROUP BY loser_id HAVING AVG(draw_size) > (SELECT AVG(avg_draw) FROM (SELECT loser_id, AVG(draw_size) as avg_draw FROM matches GROUP BY loser_id)))) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts, AVG(ranking_points) - (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) as diff FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id HAVING AVG(ranking_points) > (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) AND AVG(ranking_points) > (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id HAVING AVG(ranking_points) > (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)))) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts, AVG(ranking_points) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) as ratio, (AVG(ranking_points) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id))) - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) as ratio FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) as diff FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id HAVING (AVG(ranking_points) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id))) > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) FROM (SELECT AVG(ranking_points) as avg_pts FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) as ratio FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT winner_id, AVG(winner_age) as avg_age, AVG(winner_age) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_age) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_age) as avg_age FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id)) as ratio, (AVG(winner_age) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_age) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_age) as avg_age FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id))) - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_age) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_age) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_age) as avg_age FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id)) as ratio FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id)) as diff FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id HAVING (AVG(winner_age) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_age) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_age) as avg_age FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id))) > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_age) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_age) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_age) as avg_age FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id)) as ratio FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id)) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT player_id, AVG(tours) as avg_tours, AVG(tours) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_tours) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) as ratio, (AVG(tours) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_tours) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id))) - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_tours) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) as ratio FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) as diff FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id HAVING (AVG(tours) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_tours) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id))) > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_tours) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) as ratio FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id)) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_points FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.player_id, s1.avg_points, s1.avg_points / s2.overall_avg as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.player_id, s3.avg_points, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4) SELECT * FROM step5 ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT tourney_level, AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rank_points FROM matches GROUP BY tourney_level), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_loser_rank_points) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.tourney_level, s1.avg_loser_rank_points, s1.avg_loser_rank_points - s2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.avg_loser_rank_points > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_loser_rank_points) as avg_avg_points FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.tourney_level, s3.avg_loser_rank_points, s3.diff, s3.diff - s4.avg_avg_points as final_diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4) SELECT * FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_id, COUNT(*) as match_count FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(match_count) as total_matches FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.match_count, s1.match_count / s2.total_matches as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT SUM(match_count) as total_count FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.winner_id, s3.match_count, s3.ratio, s3.match_count / s4.total_count as final_ratio FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4) SELECT * FROM step5 ORDER BY final_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_ioc, COUNT(*) as wins FROM matches GROUP BY winner_ioc), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(wins) as total_wins FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.winner_ioc, step1.wins, step1.wins * 1.0 / step2.total_wins as proportion FROM step1, step2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.winner_ioc, step3.wins, step3.proportion, step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as deviation FROM step3, step4 ORDER BY deviation DESC) SELECT * FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.loser_id, p.hand, AVG(m.draw_size) as avg_draw_size, AVG(m.loser_ht) as avg_loser_ht FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.loser_id WHERE p.hand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_draw_size) as avg_draw_size, AVG(avg_loser_ht) as avg_loser_ht FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_loser_ht) as overall_avg_height FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.hand, step2.avg_draw_size, step2.avg_loser_ht, step2.avg_loser_ht - step3.overall_avg_height as diff FROM step2, step3 WHERE step2.avg_loser_ht > step3.overall_avg_height) SELECT AVG(avg_draw_size), AVG(avg_loser_ht), AVG(diff) FROM step4

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_id, AVG(draw_size) as avg_draw_size FROM matches WHERE draw_size IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_draw_size) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.winner_id, step1.avg_draw_size, step1.avg_draw_size / step2.overall_avg as ratio FROM step1, step2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.winner_id, step3.avg_draw_size, step3.ratio, step3.avg_draw_size - step4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3, step4 WHERE step3.ratio > step4.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(avg_draw_size), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.draw_size) as avg_draw_size FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE p.hand IS NOT NULL AND m.draw_size IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_draw_size) as avg_draw_size_by_hand FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_draw_size_by_hand) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.hand, step2.avg_draw_size_by_hand, step2.avg_draw_size_by_hand - step3.overall_avg as diff FROM step2, step3 WHERE step2.avg_draw_size_by_hand > step3.overall_avg), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step4) SELECT step4.hand, step4.avg_draw_size_by_hand, step4.diff, step4.avg_draw_size_by_hand - step5.avg_diff as final_diff FROM step4, step5

SELECT AVG(step1.avg_winner_rp) as avg_col3, AVG(step1.ratio) as avg_col4, AVG(step1.diff) as avg_col5 FROM (SELECT s1.loser_id, s1.hand, s1.avg_winner_rp, s1.avg_winner_rp / (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_winner_rp) FROM (SELECT AVG(m.winner_rank_points) as avg_winner_rp FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.loser_id GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand) s2) as ratio, s1.avg_winner_rp - (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_winner_rp) FROM (SELECT AVG(m.winner_rank_points) as avg_winner_rp FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.loser_id GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand) s2) as diff FROM (SELECT m.loser_id, p.hand, AVG(m.winner_rank_points) as avg_winner_rp FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.loser_id GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand) s1 INNER JOIN (SELECT p.hand, AVG(step1.avg_winner_rp) as hand_avg FROM (SELECT m.loser_id, p.hand, AVG(m.winner_rank_points) as avg_winner_rp FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.loser_id GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand) as step1 GROUP BY p.hand) hand_avgs ON s1.hand = hand_avgs.hand WHERE s1.avg_winner_rp > hand_avgs.hand_avg) step1

SELECT AVG(s1.avg_loser_rp) as avg_col2, AVG(s1.diff1) as avg_col3, AVG(s1.diff2) as avg_col4 FROM (SELECT s1.surface, s1.avg_loser_rp, s1.avg_loser_rp - (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_loser_rp) FROM (SELECT AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rp FROM matches GROUP BY surface) s2) as diff1, s1.avg_loser_rp - (SELECT AVG(s3.avg_loser_rp) FROM (SELECT surface, AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rp FROM matches GROUP BY surface) s3 WHERE s3.avg_loser_rp > (SELECT AVG(s4.avg_loser_rp) FROM (SELECT AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rp FROM matches GROUP BY surface) s4)) as diff2 FROM (SELECT surface, AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rp FROM matches GROUP BY surface) s1 WHERE s1.avg_loser_rp > (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_loser_rp) FROM (SELECT AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rp FROM matches GROUP BY surface) s2)) s1 WHERE s1.avg_loser_rp > (SELECT AVG(s3.avg_loser_rp) FROM (SELECT surface, AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rp FROM matches GROUP BY surface) s3 WHERE s3.avg_loser_rp > (SELECT AVG(s4.avg_loser_rp) FROM (SELECT AVG(loser_rank_points) as avg_loser_rp FROM matches GROUP BY surface) s4))

SELECT step2.hand, step2.hand_avg, step2.hand_avg - (SELECT AVG(step3.hand_avg) FROM (SELECT p.hand, AVG(step1.avg_loser_age) as hand_avg FROM (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_age) as avg_loser_age FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand) step1 GROUP BY p.hand) step3) as diff FROM (SELECT p.hand, AVG(step1.avg_loser_age) as hand_avg FROM (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_age) as avg_loser_age FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand) step1 GROUP BY p.hand) step2 WHERE step2.hand_avg > (SELECT AVG(step3.hand_avg) FROM (SELECT p.hand, AVG(step1.avg_loser_age) as hand_avg FROM (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_age) as avg_loser_age FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand) step1 GROUP BY p.hand) step3)

SELECT AVG(s1.avg_tours) as avg_col2, AVG(s1.diff1) as avg_col3, AVG(s1.diff2) as avg_col4 FROM (SELECT s1.player_id, s1.avg_tours, s1.avg_tours - (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_tours) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id) s2) as diff1, s1.avg_tours - (SELECT AVG(s3.avg_tours) FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id) s3 WHERE s3.avg_tours > (SELECT AVG(s4.avg_tours) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id) s4)) as diff2 FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id) s1 WHERE s1.avg_tours > (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_tours) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id) s2)) s1 WHERE s1.avg_tours > (SELECT AVG(s3.avg_tours) FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id) s3 WHERE s3.avg_tours > (SELECT AVG(s4.avg_tours) FROM (SELECT AVG(tours) as avg_tours FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id) s4))

SELECT AVG(s1.avg_winner_ht) as avg_col2, AVG(s1.diff1) as avg_col3, AVG(s1.diff2) as avg_col4 FROM (SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.avg_winner_ht, s1.avg_winner_ht - (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_winner_ht) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id) s2) as diff1, s1.avg_winner_ht - (SELECT AVG(s3.avg_winner_ht) FROM (SELECT winner_id, AVG(winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id) s3 WHERE s3.avg_winner_ht > (SELECT AVG(s4.avg_winner_ht) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id) s4)) as diff2 FROM (SELECT winner_id, AVG(winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id) s1 WHERE s1.avg_winner_ht > (SELECT AVG(s2.avg_winner_ht) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id) s2)) s1 WHERE s1.avg_winner_ht > (SELECT AVG(s3.avg_winner_ht) FROM (SELECT winner_id, AVG(winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id) s3 WHERE s3.avg_winner_ht > (SELECT AVG(s4.avg_winner_ht) FROM (SELECT AVG(winner_ht) as avg_winner_ht FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id) s4))

WITH step1 AS (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as col2 FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(col2) as col1 FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.player_id as col1, step1.col2 as col2, (step1.col2 - step2.col1) as col3 FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.col1 IS NOT NULL AND step1.col2 > step2.col1), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(col2) as col1 FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.col1 as col1, step3.col2 as col2, step3.col3 as col3, (step3.col2 - step4.col1) as col4 FROM step3, step4 WHERE step4.col1 IS NOT NULL AND step3.col2 > step4.col1) SELECT AVG(col2), AVG(col3), AVG(col4) FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT player_id, AVG(ranking_points) as avg_points FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.player_id, step1.avg_points, step1.avg_points / step2.overall_avg as ratio FROM step1, step2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.player_id, step3.avg_points, step3.ratio, step3.avg_points - step4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3, step4 WHERE step3.avg_points > step4.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(avg_points), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM step5
SELECT * FROM step6

SELECT loser_id, hand, avg_draw, ht_ratio, rnk FROM step2 WHERE rnk <= 3
SELECT * FROM step3
SELECT * FROM step3

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.draw_size) as avg_draw, AVG(m.winner_ht / NULLIF(m.loser_ht, 0)) as avg_ratio FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE m.loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.hand, s1.avg_draw, s1.avg_ratio, s1.avg_ratio / s2.overall_avg as ratio_div FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio_div DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(loser_age) as avg_age, AVG((winner_rank_points - NULLIF(loser_rank_points, 0)) / loser_rank_points) as avg_ratio FROM matches WHERE loser_hand IS NOT NULL AND loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_age) as overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT s1.loser_hand, s1.avg_age, s1.avg_ratio, s1.avg_age - s2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, AVG(loser_age - winner_age) as avg_age_diff, AVG((winner_ht - NULLIF(loser_ht, 0)) / loser_ht) as avg_ht_ratio FROM matches WHERE loser_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_age_diff) as overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT s1.loser_id, s1.avg_age_diff, s1.avg_ht_ratio, s1.avg_age_diff - s2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.loser_id, p.hand, AVG(CAST(m.loser_age AS REAL) - CAST(m.winner_age AS REAL)) as col3, AVG(CAST(m.loser_ht AS REAL) - CAST(m.winner_ht AS REAL)) as col4 FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.loser_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.loser_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT p.hand as col1, AVG(col3) as col2, AVG(col4) as col3 FROM step1 GROUP BY p.hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(col3) as avg_col3 FROM step2 WHERE col3 IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT s2.col1, s2.col2, s2.col3, s2.col3 - s3.avg_col3 as col4 FROM step2 s2, step3 s3 WHERE s3.avg_col3 IS NOT NULL AND s2.col3 > s3.avg_col3) SELECT s2.col1, AVG(s2.col2) as result2, AVG(s2.col3) as result3, AVG(s2.col3 - s3.avg_col3) as result4 FROM step2 s2, step3 s3 WHERE s3.avg_col3 IS NOT NULL AND s2.col3 > s3.avg_col3 GROUP BY s2.col1

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(CAST(m.loser_age AS REAL) - CAST(m.winner_age AS REAL)) as col3, AVG(CAST(m.loser_ht AS REAL) - CAST(m.winner_ht AS REAL)) as col4 FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT p.hand as col1, AVG(col3) as col2, AVG(col4) as col3 FROM step1 GROUP BY p.hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(col2) as avg_col2 FROM step2 WHERE col2 IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT s2.col1, s2.col2, s2.col3, s2.col2 - s3.avg_col2 as col4 FROM step2 s2, step3 s3 WHERE s3.avg_col2 IS NOT NULL AND s2.col2 > s3.avg_col2) SELECT s2.col1, AVG(s2.col2) as result2, AVG(s2.col3) as result3, AVG(s2.col2 - s3.avg_col2) as result4 FROM step2 s2, step3 s3 WHERE s3.avg_col2 IS NOT NULL AND s2.col2 > s3.avg_col2 GROUP BY s2.col1

WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.winner_id, p.hand, AVG(m.loser_age) as avg_loser_age, AVG(CASE WHEN m.winner_ht IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_ht != 0 THEN (CAST(m.loser_ht - m.winner_ht AS REAL) / m.winner_ht) ELSE NULL END) as avg_height_ratio FROM matches m JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT hand, AVG(avg_loser_age) as avg_age, AVG(avg_height_ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step1 GROUP BY hand), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio FROM step2) SELECT step2.hand, step2.avg_age, step2.avg_ratio, step2.avg_ratio - step3.overall_avg_ratio as diff FROM step2, step3 WHERE step3.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_id, AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as rank_diff FROM matches WHERE loser_rank_points IS NOT NULL AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(rank_diff) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.rank_diff, s1.rank_diff / NULLIF(s2.overall_avg, 0) as ratio FROM step1 s1, step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(s3.ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3 s3), final AS (SELECT s3.winner_id, s3.rank_diff, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as final_diff FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 ORDER BY final_diff DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT * FROM final

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, AVG(CAST(loser_ht AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(winner_ht, 0)) as height_ratio FROM matches WHERE loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(height_ratio) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.loser_id, s1.height_ratio, s1.height_ratio / NULLIF(s2.overall_avg, 0) as ratio FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s1.height_ratio > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(height_ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT s3.loser_id, s3.height_ratio, s3.ratio, s3.height_ratio - s4.avg_ratio as final_diff FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 ORDER BY final_diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT winner_ioc, AVG(CAST(winner_rank_points AS REAL) / loser_rank_points) as avg_ratio
  FROM matches
  GROUP BY winner_ioc
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.winner_ioc, s1.avg_ratio,
         s1.avg_ratio / s2.overall_avg as normalized
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(normalized) as avg_normalized
  FROM step3
)
SELECT s3.winner_ioc, s3.avg_ratio, s3.normalized,
       s3.avg_ratio - s4.avg_normalized as diff
FROM step3 s3, step4 s4
WHERE s4.avg_normalized IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT winner_id, AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as avg_diff
  FROM matches
  GROUP BY winner_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_diff) as overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.winner_id, s1.avg_diff,
         s1.avg_diff - s2.overall_avg as diff
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(diff) as avg_diff
  FROM step3
)
SELECT s3.winner_id, s3.avg_diff, s3.diff,
       CAST(s3.avg_diff AS REAL) / NULLIF(s4.avg_diff, 0) as ratio
FROM step3 s3, step4 s4
WHERE s4.avg_diff IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT loser_hand, AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as avg_diff
  FROM matches
  GROUP BY loser_hand
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_diff) as overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.loser_hand, s1.avg_diff,
         s1.avg_diff - s2.overall_avg as diff
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
  WHERE s1.avg_diff > s2.overall_avg
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(diff) as avg_diff
  FROM step3
)
SELECT s3.loser_hand, s3.avg_diff, s3.diff,
       CAST(s3.avg_diff AS REAL) / NULLIF(s4.avg_diff, 0) as ratio
FROM step3 s3, step4 s4
WHERE s4.avg_diff IS NOT NULL

SELECT step3.hand, step3.count, step3.proportion, step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as diff FROM (SELECT p.hand, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matches m2 JOIN players p2 ON p2.player_id = m2.winner_id WHERE p2.hand IS NOT NULL) as proportion FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE p.hand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.hand) step3, (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matches m2 JOIN players p2 ON p2.player_id = m2.winner_id WHERE p2.hand IS NOT NULL) as proportion FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE p.hand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.hand)) step4

WITH step1 AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(cnt AS REAL)) as avg_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.player_id, step1.cnt, step1.cnt / step2.avg_cnt as ratio FROM step1, step2 WHERE NOT (step2.avg_cnt IS NULL)), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.player_id, step3.cnt, step3.ratio, step3.ratio - step4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3, step4 WHERE NOT (step4.avg_ratio IS NULL) AND step3.ratio > step4.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(CAST(cnt AS REAL)), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, AVG(CAST(loser_ht - winner_ht AS REAL)) as avg_ht_diff FROM matches WHERE loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ht_diff) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.loser_id, step1.avg_ht_diff, step1.avg_ht_diff - step2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE NOT (step2.overall_avg IS NULL)), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ht_diff) as avg_avg_ht_diff FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.loser_id, step3.avg_ht_diff, step3.diff, step3.diff - step4.avg_avg_ht_diff as diff2 FROM step3, step4 WHERE NOT (step4.avg_avg_ht_diff IS NULL) AND step3.avg_ht_diff > step4.avg_avg_ht_diff) SELECT AVG(avg_ht_diff), AVG(diff), AVG(diff2) FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_id, AVG(CAST(loser_age - winner_age AS REAL)) as avg_age_diff FROM matches WHERE loser_age IS NOT NULL AND winner_age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_age_diff) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.winner_id, step1.avg_age_diff, step1.avg_age_diff - step2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE NOT (step2.overall_avg IS NULL)), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_age_diff) as avg_avg_age_diff FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.winner_id, step3.avg_age_diff, step3.diff, step3.diff - step4.avg_avg_age_diff as diff2 FROM step3, step4 WHERE NOT (step4.avg_avg_age_diff IS NULL) AND step3.avg_age_diff > step4.avg_avg_age_diff) SELECT AVG(avg_age_diff), AVG(diff), AVG(diff2) FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, COUNT(*) as loss_count FROM matches GROUP BY loser_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(loss_count) as avg_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.loser_id, s1.loss_count, CAST(s1.loss_count AS FLOAT) / s2.avg_count as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.avg_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.loss_count, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as difference FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(s5.loss_count), AVG(s5.ratio), AVG(s5.difference) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_id, AVG(CAST(winner_age AS FLOAT) / loser_age) as metric FROM matches WHERE loser_age IS NOT NULL AND loser_age != 0 GROUP BY loser_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(metric) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.metric, CAST(s1.metric AS FLOAT) / s2.overall_avg as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s2.overall_avg != 0), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.metric, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as difference FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(s5.metric), AVG(s5.ratio), AVG(s5.difference) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_id, AVG(CAST(loser_ht AS FLOAT) / winner_ht) as metric FROM matches WHERE loser_ht IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht IS NOT NULL AND winner_ht != 0 GROUP BY winner_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(metric) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.metric, s1.metric - s2.overall_avg as difference FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.metric > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(metric) as avg_metric FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.metric, s3.difference, s3.difference - s4.avg_metric as final_diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_metric IS NOT NULL AND s3.difference > s4.avg_metric) SELECT AVG(s5.metric), AVG(s5.difference), AVG(s5.final_diff) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT loser_hand, AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as metric FROM matches GROUP BY loser_hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(metric) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.metric, CAST(s1.metric AS FLOAT) / s2.overall_avg as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s2.overall_avg != 0), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.metric, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as difference FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(s5.metric), AVG(s5.ratio), AVG(s5.difference) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.hand, AVG(CAST(m.loser_age AS FLOAT) / m.winner_age) as metric FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE m.loser_age IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_age IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_age != 0 GROUP BY p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(metric) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.metric, CAST(s1.metric AS FLOAT) / s2.overall_avg as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s2.overall_avg != 0), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.metric, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as difference FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(s5.metric), AVG(s5.ratio), AVG(s5.difference) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.hand, AVG(m.loser_age - m.winner_age) as metric FROM matches m JOIN players p ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE m.loser_age IS NOT NULL AND m.winner_age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.hand), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(metric) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.metric, s1.metric - s2.overall_avg as difference FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(metric) as avg_metric FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.metric, s3.difference, s3.difference - s4.avg_metric as final_diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_metric IS NOT NULL AND s3.difference > s4.avg_metric) SELECT AVG(s5.metric), AVG(s5.difference), AVG(s5.final_diff) FROM step5 s5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT winner_id, AVG(loser_rank_points - winner_rank_points) as metric FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(metric) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.metric, s1.metric - s2.overall_avg as difference FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.metric > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(metric) as avg_metric FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.metric, s3.difference, s3.difference - s4.avg_metric as final_diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_metric IS NOT NULL AND s3.difference > s4.avg_metric) SELECT AVG(s5.metric), AVG(s5.difference), AVG(s5.final_diff) FROM step5 s5
